messages:
anna_sales: Quick ask — BigBank POC kickoff. They require strict EU-only residency, BYO-KMS, and want assurance that inference traffic never egresses via the US. Also need a ballpark delta on pricing if we pin tenant to eu-west dedicated vs hosted. Procurement wants an answer by EOD.

lisa_cloudops: Do we have a tenant ID or a list of exact regions they prefer (eu-west1 / eu-west2)? We have EU-only hosting in eu-west1 and eu-west2, and an EU subprocessor set — but need to confirm for BYO-KMS flow.

anna_sales: No tenant yet — still in presales. Preference is eu-west1, but they'll accept eu-west2 if latency difference is negligible.

tom_sre: FYI we support tenant pinning via routing policy -> geo_affinity + region_preference. If pinned to eu-west1 we keep inference on that pool unless capacity constrained, then fallback goes to a compatible EU-only pool (not US) if configured. Example snippet for policy:
```
routing: 
  tenant_pin: true
  preferred_regions: ["eu-west1"]
  fallback_policy: "eu-eu"  # prefer EU pools only
```
Note: you must opt into the EU-only fallback set; otherwise default can fallthrough.

jordan_security: BYO-KMS: supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted API has a limited BYO option via our HSM partner but it still touches our control plane (need DPA + attestation). For strict EU crypto boundary we recommend Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS in their EU project. Also need to confirm whether their procurement expects our subprocessor list and SOC2/SOC3.

mike_se: Ballpark on pricing deltas:
- Hosted (EU region, no pin): baseline. No commit, slightly lower unit cost but egress routing fallthrough risk.
- Hosted + EU-only routing opt-in: +~5% token premium (affinity + soft capacity controls).
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in eu-west1): +~40–60% on effective per-token cost depending on commit level, but predictable and stays in EU.
- BYO-KMS on Dedicated/Private: one-time setup fee + nominal monthly for key proxy service (~$1k–5k/month depending on throughput). Egress costs depend on customer's cloud/provider peering. I can run a quick estimate if you share expected qps & monthly tokens.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-123 — "POC BigBank EU residency & BYO-KMS network review". Assigned to tom_sre.

anna_sales: Thanks — can someone draft a one-pager I can send to procurement listing: supported EU regions, subprocessor list link, BYO-KMS constraints, fallback behavior, and a rough pricing delta? Need it short.

tom_sre: I can draft the network/residency portion + routing example. Blockers to call out: 1) legal sign-off on subprocessor list, 2) validated region for KMS key residency, 3) certs for any cross-account VPC peering if they want Dedicated private peering.

jordan_security: I'll produce a short security blurb: BYO-KMS supported on Dedicated/Private (customer-controlled keys in EU), hosted BYO limited and requires DPA addendum + attestation. We can include SOC2 + penetration test summary. Also: we can guarantee inference compute stays in EU pools if tenant_pin + EU-only fallback are configured, but we cannot guarantee zero cross-border network hops if the customer's own infrastructure calls back to non-EU endpoints. Call that out.

mike_se: Action items from me: 1) rough quote for eu-west1 Dedicated commit (I need expected monthly tokens and target qps), 2) hosted EU-only premium estimate, 3) BYO-KMS setup cost range. If you drop numbers I’ll turn around a rough quote in <24h.

anna_sales: I'll gather numbers from the customer this afternoon and post them here. Thanks all — can we aim to have the one-pager + quote draft ready tomorrow morning? :thumbsup:

tom_sre: Yep — will post a short residency + routing one-pager by 10:30am tomorrow.

jordan_security: Will append the security checklist & attestation links.

mike_se: I'll queue the cost calc once Anna posts numbers.

anna_sales: Sending numbers soon. Appreciate fast turnaround. :pray:
